about_the_game:
Step into a neon-lit world where music is the key to growth! In this rhythm game, your musical actions guide the evolution of seeds that grow in sync with the beat. With electrifying visuals and challenging mechanics, every session tests your precision and timing.

Key Features:

  • Immersive Rhythm Gameplay: Hit the correct notes with the keyboard while using the mouse to catch additional notes that appear on the screen.Each well-timed note feeds your seed, helping it evolve through three spectacular phases.
  • Visual Evolution: As the song progresses, watch your seed grow and transform, reaching its final, fully grown phase.
  • Control Switching: At certain points, the direction of the notes will change, and you’ll need to flip the controls with a key press to keep playing. Everything flips, including the colors!
  • Neon Aesthetic: Enjoy a visual environment filled with neon lights and effects that pulse in time with the music.
  • Rhythm and Precision Challenge: Test your reflexes and adaptability in a game where every move counts, and perfect timing is key to success.



This game offers a unique experience that blends rhythm with visual evolution, challenging you to achieve the fullest growth of your seeds to the beat of the music.

Currently, this game is still in development, and we're working hard to make it even better. Add to your Wishlist to stay updated on exciting new updates!
